project.author: WarpForge Examples
project.description: Sprite runtime demo. Click the star to spawn 12 clones in a radial burst. A second sprite tracks the burst count via broadcasts. Demonstrates cloning, broadcasts, multi-sprite coordination.

workspace_state.blockly_xml:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
<block type="wf_window" id="window_main" x="24" y="24"><field name="HEIGHT">360</field><field name="TITLE">Star Burst</field><field name="WIDTH">480</field><next><block type="wf_screen" id="screen_stage"><field name="NAME">Stage</field><field name="ROUTE">/</field></block></next></block>
</xml>

sprites.name: Star
sprites.scripts_xml: <xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml"><block type="scratch_event_when_flag_clicked" id="sf_hat" x="40" y="40"><next><block type="scratch_looks_show" id="sf_show"><next><block type="scratch_motion_goto_xy" id="sf_goto"><field name="X">0</field><field name="Y">0</field><next><block type="scratch_motion_point_in_direction" id="sf_dir"><field name="DIRECTION">90</field><next><block type="scratch_looks_set_size" id="sf_size"><field name="SIZE">50</field><next><block type="scratch_looks_say_for_secs" id="sf_say"><field name="MESSAGE">Click me to burst!</field><field name="SECS">2</field></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block></next></block><block type="scratch_event_when_this_sprite_clicked" id="sc_hat" x="40" y="320"><next><block type="scratch_looks_say" id="sc_clear"><field name="MESSAGE"></field><next><block type="scratch_control_repeat" id="sc_rep"><field name="TIMES">12</field><statement name="DO"><block type="scratch_motion_turn_right" id="sc_turn"><field name="DEGREES">30</field><next><block type="scratch_control_create_clone_of" id="sc_clone"><field name="TARGET">myself</field></block></next></block></statement><next><block type="scratch_event_broadcast" id="sc_bcast"><field name="BROADCAST">burst</field></block></next></block></next></block></next></block><block type="scratch_control_when_i_start_as_clone" id="sk_hat" x="40" y="560"><next><block type="scratch_control_repeat" id="sk_rep"><field name="TIMES">25</field><statement name="DO"><block type="scratch_motion_move_steps" id="sk_move"><field name="STEPS">5</field></block></statement><next><block type="scratch_control_delete_this_clone" id="sk_del"/></next></block></next></block></xml>

sprites.name: Scorekeeper
sprites.scripts_xml: <xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml"><block type="scratch_event_when_flag_clicked" id="kf_hat" x="40" y="40"><next><block type="scratch_looks_hide" id="kf_hide"><next><block type="scratch_data_set_variable" id="kf_init"><field name="VARIABLE">bursts</field><field name="VALUE">0</field><next><block type="scratch_data_show_variable" id="kf_show"><field name="VARIABLE">bursts</field></block></next></block></next></block></next></block><block type="scratch_event_when_i_receive" id="kr_hat" x="40" y="260"><field name="BROADCAST">burst</field><next><block type="scratch_data_change_variable" id="kr_inc"><field name="VARIABLE">bursts</field><field name="VALUE">1</field></block></next></block></xml>
